entities.name: Query YbeY
observations: 157 aa bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed Salinispora tropica YbeY (UniProt A4XAD4).
Contains Pfam YbeY domain PF02130.25 at positions 6–151.
Predicted molecular weight 16.76 kDa and theoretical pI 4.39.

entities.name: YbeY endoribonuclease
observations: Single-strand-specific metallo-endoribonuclease involved in late-stage 70S ribosome quality control and maturation of the 3′ terminus of 16S rRNA.
Curated homologs bind one Zn2+ ion and are annotated with RNA endonuclease and zinc-ion-binding activities.
Curated homologs are localized to the cytoplasm.

entities.name: YbeY zinc binding
observations: Reference YbeY proteins have annotated zinc-binding sites at positions near 121, 125, and 131 and bind one Zn2+ ion; exact residue mapping to the query is not independently recalculated here.

entities.name: 16S rRNA processing
observations: YbeY participates in maturation of the 3′ terminus of 16S rRNA, a bacterial rRNA-processing process.

entities.name: 70S ribosome quality control
observations: YbeY contributes to late-stage quality control of assembled 70S bacterial ribosomes.
